emily (docs): Hey team — I'm opening a small PR to clean up the rate-limits & quotas doc. Planned changes: update quota tier names (Free -> Starter -> Scale), replace a stale dashboard link, add a tiny SDK snippet showing how to check quotas, and call out the metric name changes. Pushing draft in ~10m.

michael (product): Which dashboard link is stale? also confirm the new tier names (are we using 'Starter' vs 'Basic' now?).

samir (eng): The stale link points to /dashboards/old-quota-panel. New tiers are indeed Starter + Scale (we consolidated Basic -> Starter). For the SDK snippet, use something like:
```python
from redwood import Client
client = Client(api_key="${REDWOOD_API_KEY}")
resp = client.quotas.check(project_id="proj_abc")
if resp.get('tier') == 'Scale':
    print('high quota — consider batching')
else:
    print('within tier')
```
Also note: backend metric name changed from `requests.count` to `inference.requests.total` — docs should list both for a short migration note.

luis (analytics): fyi metrics teams also renamed token metrics -> `usage.tokens.total`. The replacement dashboard panel is here: https://console.redwood.ai/dashboards/usage?panel=quota-usage (panel id=42). Recommend updating the sample Grafana query and adding a plain-English mapping table (old -> new metric).

michael (product): can we add a short example for burst behaviour & per-route limits? customers keep asking about X-Rate-Limit headers and how burst interacts with quotas.

emily (docs): good call. I'll add a tiny table + curl snippet demonstrating headers and a short paragraph on burst windows. Example header snippet:
```
curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
# Response headers:
# X-Rate-Limit-Limit: 120
# X-Rate-Limit-Remaining: 88
# X-Rate-Limit-Reset: 1672531200
```

docs-bot: CI /docs-lint failed on PR #4567 — link-checker: broken link detected: /dashboards/old-quota-panel (see https://ci.redwood.ai/1234).

emily (docs): :grimacing: saw that. I'll update all links in the PR. planning to include the mapping table luis suggested and the SDK + curl snippets.

samir (eng): I can add a migration alias on the metrics side to accept the old metric name for 48h to smooth the rollout. I'll open an infra PR and schedule for tomorrow 10:00 PT.

luis (analytics): :thumbsup: please cc me on that infra PR so I can double-check dashboards. Also will add a short note for customers about the metric rename in the release notes.

michael (product): timeline works for me. once samir's infra PR is up, let's coordinate the docs merge right after the deploy window.

emily (docs): I'll update the PR now and tag reviewers @samir @luis @michael. Draft link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4567. Will aim to have it ready by 09:30 PT tomorrow so we can merge post-deploy.

emily (docs): One more thing — adding a tiny migration checklist in the docs: (1) update queries to `inference.requests.total` / `usage.tokens.total`, (2) switch to Starter/Scale tier names in examples, (3) replace dashboard links, (4) include X-Rate-Limit header examples.

samir (eng): Sounds good. I'll create the infra PR and ping here when it's green.

luis (analytics): I'll draft the dashboard note and paste a verification query in the PR.

emily (docs): Thanks all — I'll push the link fixes + examples now. Ping me if you want any wording changes before I merge. :rocket:
